firestore.reasoning:
Given the app's primary function is playing pre-loaded mantra tracks, and there are no user-generated content or user-specific settings, a simple, flat structure is sufficient. A single collection, `/mantra_tracks`, will store all the track data. This approach avoids unnecessary complexity and optimizes read performance for track playback. The structure ensures all documents share the same security requirements, fulfilling the homogeneous security posture requirement.

This design inherently supports Authorization Independence as there is no hierarchical relationship or user-specific data requiring complex rules. The QAP (Rules are not Filters) requirement is trivially satisfied since listing all tracks is the primary use case, and no user-specific filtering is required.
